OUR IMPACT

## We transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and
## health.

[ Our Purpose ][124]
* [
  Mobility
  [An aerial view of a highway with moving traffic.]
  We play a fundamental role in advancing the future of mobility on the road, in the air and in
  orbit—from critical materials that power battery systems, to safety components like airbag
  initiators, and more.
  ][125]
* [
  Energy
  [Aerial night view of a bustling city with illuminated skyscrapers, roads, and a few cars,
  showcasing a vibrant urban landscape.]
  We support the build-out of energy storage systems that help power data centers and ensure a more
  reliable grid.
  ][126]
* [
  Connectivity
  [A view of earth from space at night showing the planet's curved horizon. Some clouds are
  illuminated by city lights. Clusters of city lights showing in certain areas looking like
  connected light streams.]
  We enhance safety and reliability in connections, from fire safety compounds in electronics, wires
  and cables to the protective glass on phones.
  ][127]
* [
  Health
  [Grocery store produce isle]
  We produce specialty chemicals and additives for medicines, disinfectants and solutions that keep
  our food and water safe and plentiful.
  ][128]
ALBEMARLE BY THE NUMBERS


## A Global Footprint, Built for Reliable Supply

[Photo of green trees for Albemarle Sustainability 2024]

SUSTAINABILITY

## A Sustainable Future

We’re committed to sustainability in all that we do, transparently sharing insights into our
sustainability strategy, objectives and accomplishments. Our approach to environmental stewardship,
responsible sourcing, community engagement and employee welfare is a daily pursuit across all
aspects of our organization.

Our innovative technologies and practices minimize our environmental footprint and ensure a
sustainable supply of critical minerals for the future while minimizing our environmental impact
today.

[ Direct Lithium Extraction ][129] [ Sustainability at the Salar Plant ][130] [ Albemarle 2025
Sustainability Report ][131]
[A female scientist in a lab coat conducts an experiment in an industrial setting, interacting with
equipment while examining a sample in a mixing dish.]

## Let's Build a More Resilient World Together

Albemarle attracts people who want to do well by doing good. As a leader in our industries we invite
you to explore our career opportunities worldwide. 

[ View Careers ][132]
All the elements for a better world.

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the
world.
* [Liza Destiny FPSO with sunset in background]
  
  ### Upstream
  
  Focused on strengthening energy security by expanding low-cost-of-supply, high-return oil and
  natural gas operations.
  
  [Learn more about our Upstream business][124]
* [Female engineer working in Baytown Technology and Engineering Complex]
  
  ### Product Solutions
  
  Integrating our downstream and chemical operations to develop lower-emission fuels and innovative
  products critical to modern society.
  
  [Learn more about our Downstream business][125]
  [Learn more about our Chemical business][126]
* [Scientist working in a lab]
  
  ### Low Carbon Solutions
  
  Helping reduce emissions by providing solutions to our industrial and commercial customers in
  growing markets for carbon capture and storage, hydrogen and biofuels.
  
  [Learn more about our Low Carbon Solutions business][127]

## Our global brands

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated
fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the world. We’ve evolved our operating model and global
organization to better leverage the scale of our increasingly integrated company and global brands.

## [Our global organization][123]

ExxonMobil's three primary businesses provide products that enable modern life, including energy,
chemicals, lubricants, and lower-emissions technologies. We have an industry-leading portfolio of
resources, and we're one of the largest integrated fuels, lubricants and chemical companies in the

ExxonMobil manages an industry-leading portfolio of resources, and is one of the largest integrated

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

## Our Chemistry-as-a-Service™ is your Unfair Advantage.

### Dynamic Material Intelligence

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

### AI-Powered Process Optimization

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

your line, preventing problems before they start.

## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

From innovation to impact- see how we’re advancing solutions that power more sustainable products.

## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]

* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

Creating sustainable impact

## For Generations

"For Generations" signifies our dedication to acting responsibly today to ensure a positive legacy
for those who come after us. Building on our process expertise and on our core beliefs, this program
is designed to foster trust and create value for Solvay, its stakeholders, and society as a whole. 
[Learn about the program][91]
[AIR Cover_1022x506px - 1]

## Annual Integrated Report

In 2025, Solvay delivered on its commitment to excellence in both financial and sustainability
performance despite a macroeconomic environment marked by geopolitical and  economic uncertainties. 

[Read our latest Annual Report][92]
[Solvay employees in France]

## Join our team and thrive

We actively seek employees whose personal values resonate with ours, as this alignment is integral
to fulfilling our mission. The journey begins with a steadfast commitment to our company’s core
values and purpose. We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

 

[Discover Life at Solvay][93]

## We are essential chemistry, making progress possible for generations.

Solvay, a pioneering chemical company with a legacy rooted in founder Ernest Solvay's pivotal
innovations in the soda ash process, is dedicated to delivering essential solutions globally through
its workforce of around 9,000 employees. Since 1863, Solvay harnesses the power of chemistry to
create innovative, sustainable solutions that answer the world’s most essential needs such as
purifying the air we breathe and the water we use, preserving our food supplies, protecting our
health and well-being, creating eco-friendly clothing, making the tires of our cars more sustainable
and cleaning and protecting our homes. Solvay’s unwavering commitment drives the transition to a
carbon-neutral future by 2050, underscoring its dedication to sustainability and a fair and just
transition. As a world-leading company with €4.7 billion in underlying net sales in 2024, Solvay is
listed on Euronext Brussels and Paris (SOLB).

## Improving Lives Through the Positive Impact of Plastics

Ampacet products and services help customers improve the products that improve our lives.

## Meeting the Needs of Diversified Markets

New solutions to bring functionality and aesthetics to a wide variety of products.

## Insight and Innovation

Ampacet provides educational, interactive sessions to help customers discover exciting new visions
for their products and brands.

## Sustainable Business Model

Ampacet R³ Sustainable Solutions represent our commitment to the global circular economy with a
growing portfolio of innovative masterbatches benefiting customers, the industry and the planet.

## Innovative Solutions for Packaging

Our colors and additives for consumer packaging are used in a wide variety of processes including
single & multi-layer films, blow molding, injection molding & extrusion.

## In-line Color Management and Correction Technologies

Featuring Spectro 4.0 ™ continuous in-line color management system plus automated resin
management/blending systems and a complete line of precision color and additive feeders.

## Infrastructure and Industrial Applications

We develop additives for new molded industrial parts, film/sheet, wire and cable, pipe, drain tile
and plumbing goods. Applications include house wrap, geomembranes, molded drums, pails, pallets,
bins and totes.

## Improving Lives Through the Positive Impact of Plastics

Ampacet products and services help customers improve the products that improve our lives.

## Meeting the Needs of Diversified Markets

New solutions to bring functionality and aesthetics to a wide variety of products.

## Insight and Innovation

Ampacet provides educational, interactive sessions to help customers discover exciting new visions
for their products and brands.

## Sustainable Business Model

Ampacet R³ Sustainable Solutions represent our commitment to the global circular economy with a
growing portfolio of innovative masterbatches benefiting customers, the industry and the planet.

## Innovative Solutions for Packaging

Our colors and additives for consumer packaging are used in a wide variety of processes including
single & multi-layer films, blow molding, injection molding & extrusion.

## In-line Color Management and Correction Technologies

Featuring Spectro 4.0 ™ continuous in-line color management system plus automated resin
management/blending systems and a complete line of precision color and additive feeders.

## Infrastructure and Industrial Applications

We develop additives for new molded industrial parts, film/sheet, wire and cable, pipe, drain tile
and plumbing goods. Applications include house wrap, geomembranes, molded drums, pails, pallets,
bins and totes.

# Grow Your Brand with Breakthrough!

**Focus, Expand, Add Value & Innovate**

Does your business growth plan include launching new products? Curious who will pay and how to get
them to buy? We can help you with that. We give you the facts and support your need to meet and
exceed your growth goals.
[ Book A Consultation ][52]

## Accelerate Your Business Growth With Jade
* Gain insights into customer motivations for purchasing
* Transform complex market data into actionable growth plans
* Increase customer base and revenue growth
* Tackle business-critical issues with real marketplace facts

[ See Jade 2.0 in Action ][53]
* What We Do
[ Innovative Business Transformation ][54]

The process to make strategic product and marketing decisions starts with your internal vision and
adds insights into what markets will value.

[ Voice of the Customer ][55]

Our Voice of the Customer engagements go well beyond traditional market research. We design and
deploy a set of choice exercises that elicit a variety of market perceptions.

[ Market-Driven Innovation ][56]

Our roadmaps are based on a deep intelligence on specific markets, customer needs, and their desired
outcomes.

[ Ingredient Branding ][57]

An ingredient brand not only adds value to the host brand’s equity, but in mature markets, it can
also create or enhance differentiation.

[ Multicultural Marketing ][58]

We help clients develop, understand, and implement multicultural marketing strategies to improve
business—from strategy creation through implementation.

[ See More of What We Do ][59]

## A Glimpse Into Our Insights

Insights gathered from many years of advising clients in a variety of industries. Read our insights
into what drives business growth, innovation, and brand value.

[ View All Insights ][60]

### [ When Customer Inaction Becomes Your Biggest Competitor ][62]

Many organizations believe they lose opportunities to competitors. In reality, the biggest
competitor is often no decision at all. Understanding why buyers choose inaction can help
go-to-market leaders reduce decision friction and create buying experiences that move customers
forward.

[ Read More » ][63]

[prototyping culture creative workspace with geometric designs]

### [ Prototyping Culture: Designing Change Through Experimentation ][65]

Culture rarely changes because an organization announces a new set of values. Lasting change occurs
when people experience new ways of working. Design thinking and experimentation help organizations
prototype behaviors, strengthen collaboration, and build organizational cultures that evolve through
practice rather than intention alone.

[ Read More » ][66]

[ Read More » ][69]

# global provider of Halogen-free flame retardants, AND MUCH MORE.

Our dream from Day One has been to serve as a leading global connector and facilitator in the field
of international trade - pulling together both supplier and customer to work on large-scale
initiatives with the ability to transform an entire industry for the better - whether it be from an
economic, environmental, or social perspective.

 

Since 1976, Century Multech has been a quality chemical supplier & distributor of raw materials to 
diverse industries, including plastics, resins, wood, paper, electronics, automotives, and
construction. We pride ourselves in providing you with the highest quality products at competitive
price and service.  Our customers are located all across North America, Europe, Asia, and South
America. 

 

We supply chemicals that can serve many purposes, including [flame retardants][9], lubricants, and
solvents for carbon dioxide gas treatment.  And we are always on the look out for the latest news in
product development, which could reshape the USA and international chemical communities.

 

The large majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and either melamine or
phosphorus-based. Currently, we are a leading provider of [melamine cyanurate][10]﻿ (flame retardant
additive used primarily for nylon 6, and nylon 66) - available in granular, powder, or customized
form. 

 

Additional notable flame retardants and chemical additives that we can provide you, include
[melamine polyphosphate][11] (MPP) and [melamine phosphate][12] (MP) both applicable for nylon and
coatings, [ammonium polyphosphate][13] in various forms (water-soluble, melamine-treated,
epoxy-treated, etc.), and [melamine][14] crystals (for formaldehyde resins, laminates,
particleboards, coatings, etc.), and much more.

 

If you need more information, please [contact us][15] or call 718-353-9885.

## Century Multech Flame Retardants

[ [flame retardants] ][16]
[**Flame Retardants**][17]
 
The majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and melamine or phosphorus based.  For
example, we supply MCA (melamine cyanurate) for nylon 6 or nylon 66, MPP (melamine polyphosphate)
for glass-reinforced nylon, and APP (ammonium polyphosphate) ideal for intumescent coatings.

# global provider of Halogen-free flame retardants, AND MUCH MORE.

Our dream from Day One has been to serve as a leading global connector and facilitator in the field
of international trade - pulling together both supplier and customer to work on large-scale
initiatives with the ability to transform an entire industry for the better - whether it be from an
economic, environmental, or social perspective.

 

Since 1976, Century Multech has been a quality chemical supplier & distributor of raw materials to 
diverse industries, including plastics, resins, wood, paper, electronics, automotives, and
construction. We pride ourselves in providing you with the highest quality products at competitive
price and service.  Our customers are located all across North America, Europe, Asia, and South
America. 

 

We supply chemicals that can serve many purposes, including [flame retardants][9], lubricants, and
solvents for carbon dioxide gas treatment.  And we are always on the look out for the latest news in
product development, which could reshape the USA and international chemical communities.

 

The large majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and either melamine or
phosphorus-based. Currently, we are a leading provider of [melamine cyanurate][10]﻿ (flame retardant
additive used primarily for nylon 6, and nylon 66) - available in granular, powder, or customized
form. 

 

Additional notable flame retardants and chemical additives that we can provide you, include
[melamine polyphosphate][11] (MPP) and [melamine phosphate][12] (MP) both applicable for nylon and
coatings, [ammonium polyphosphate][13] in various forms (water-soluble, melamine-treated,
epoxy-treated, etc.), and [melamine][14] crystals (for formaldehyde resins, laminates,
particleboards, coatings, etc.), and much more.

 

If you need more information, please [contact us][15] or call 718-353-9885.

## Century Multech Flame Retardants

[ [flame retardants] ][16]
[**Flame Retardants**][17]
 
The majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and melamine or phosphorus based.  For
example, we supply MCA (melamine cyanurate) for nylon 6 or nylon 66, MPP (melamine polyphosphate)
for glass-reinforced nylon, and APP (ammonium polyphosphate) ideal for intumescent coatings.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

AvailOm^{®} from Evonik delivers EPA and DHA as free fatty acids in a solid omega-3 lysine complex,

### The Role of Potassium Iodide as a Dietary Supplement

Potassium iodide (KI) is one of the most widely used and bioavailable forms of iodine

### Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ Laminating Adhesives

Bostik PURELAM™ and PURETHANE™ laminating adhesives deliver fast cure, high line speeds, and

[Read Article][125]

### Lubrication Troubleshooting Playbook: Symptoms, Causes, and Fixes

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize
the use of the right lubricant for the operating conditions, material set, failure mode, and
maintenance interval.
[Read Article][126]

### What Is N,N-Dimethylacetoacetamide (DMAA)?

What is DMAA? Learn how N,N-dimethylacetoacetamide functions as a resin copromoter and chemical
intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.
[Read Article][127]

### Application Lab Testing for Camlin Fine Sciences Antioxidants

Camlin Fine Sciences (CFS) operates a dedicated Customer Application Lab staffed with technical
experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.
[Read Article][128]

### Eastman - Role of Triethyl Phosphate in PVC

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!
[Read Article][129]

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

Sourcing is not just about getting lubricants in stock. It is about helping maintenance standardize

maintenance interval.

intermediate for coatings, polymers, and synthesis.

experts who evaluate, validate, and fine-tune antioxidant performance in your system.

Discover how triethyl phosphate enhances PVC flexibility and fire resistance as a co-plasticizer and
flame-retardant. Request an Eastman TEP sample today!

### DOWFROST™ LC for Data Center Liquid Cooling

DOWFROST™ LC is an inhibited propylene glycol-based heat transfer fluid designed specifically for
liquid cooling systems where thermal performance, corrosion protection, freeze protection, and
system compatibility are critical. Its primary applications in data center environments are
Direct-to-Chip cooling and support for in-rack closed-loop and in-row close-coupled cooling systems.

branchenübergreifendes Netzwerk für faserbasierte Hochleistungsanwendungen. Die Mitgliedschaft
eröffnet Zugang zu wertvollen B2B-Kontakten und gemeinsamen Projekten, stärkt durch gezielte
Öffentlichkeitsarbeit Ihre Sichtbarkeit und bietet Wissenstransfer, vielfältige Bildungsangebote
sowie Unterstützung bei der Erschließung internationaler Märkte.

## Ihre Mitgliedschaft im Composites United e.V.

Rund 350 Mitglieder aus Industrie und angewandter Forschung bilden im Composites United ein starkes,
branchenübergreifendes Netzwerk für faserbasierte Hochleistungsanwendungen. Die Mitgliedschaft
eröffnet Zugang zu wertvollen B2B-Kontakten und gemeinsamen Projekten, stärkt durch gezielte
Öffentlichkeitsarbeit Ihre Sichtbarkeit und bietet Wissenstransfer, vielfältige Bildungsangebote
sowie Unterstützung bei der Erschließung internationaler Märkte.

[ Mehrwerte entdecken ][12]

## ITHEC 2026 - Jetzt Tickets und Ausstellungsflächen buchen!

Die ITHEC - renommierte internationale Konferenz und Ausstellung für thermoplastische
Verbundwerkstoffe - findet vom 28. bis 29. Oktober 2026 in Bremen statt. Sichern Sie sich jetzt Ihr
Ticket und planen Sie Ihre Beteiligung!

consulting services, and analytical information on markets and companies across the world. Data
Insights Market partners with clients in many countries and industry verticals such as A & D,

Since its inception, Data Insights Market has continued to innovate, increased its product and
service portfolio, and remained focused on the needs of its clients to root out poor-quality data
and establish itself as a winning partner for businesses. DIM has a legacy of serving and

clients include many types of organizations, the majority of which are Fortune 500 companies.

publications, decades of trade data, technical and white papers. We also offer services based on the

### Green & Sustainable

Decision has always adhered to the concept of green environmental protection and sustainable
development, adhered to green tanning and harmonious development in the process of enterprise

providing high-quality environmentally friendly products.

## PRODUCTS

[
[Inorganic Flame Retardant]

### Inorganic Flame Retardant

Common inorganic flame retardants include aluminum hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide, antimony oxide,
molybdenum compounds, etc. Appropriate formulations of these flame retardants allow the material to
meet a variety of test requirements.

Learn More
][145] [
[Halogen Flame Retardant]

### Halogen Flame Retardant

Halogen-based flame retardants are a class of flame retardants that contain halogen elements and act
as flame retardants with halogen elements. In fact, chlorine-based and bromine-based flame
retardants are widely used.

Learn More
][146] [
[Phosphorus Flame Retardant]

### Phosphorus Flame Retardant

Phosphorus-based flame retardants are the most important kind of flame retardants, and can be
divided into inorganic phosphorus-based flame retardants and organic phosphorus-based flame
retardants.

Learn More
][147]

## SERVICES

Flame retardants are additives used to prevent materials from being ignited and inhibit the spread
of flames, which are mainly used in the flame retardant treatment of polymer materials.
Alfa Chemistry researches, develops, manufactures and analyzes a full range of flame retardants to
meet customers' flame retardant material needs in different fields.

[Learn About Our Service Project][148] [Contact Our Technical Team][149]

As a global contract research organization (CRO) headquartered in New York, USA, Alfa Chemistry has
been serving the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries for many years. Today, the business
scope of Alfa Chemistry has expanded into the field of flame retardant materials.

Alfa Chemistry is committed to providing innovative and cost attractive flame retardant and smoke
suppressant technologies to various industries.

Backed by a customer-focused application and R&D team, Alfa Chemistry provides the best flame
retardant material solutions.

## ATO Supply Is
## Constrained.

China’s antimony export restrictions, mine curtailments, and U.S. trade policy have sent ATO spot
pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month lead times industry-wide.

Flamisol supplies three zinc-based synergists specifically qualified for ATO reduction and
replacement in halogenated PVC, polyolefin, and engineering plastic compounds.

[View Zinc Alternatives][48] [Read Market Brief][49]

China's export controls on antimony, classified as a strategic material in 2024, combined with mine
curtailments and U.S. trade policy have pushed ATO spot pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month
lead times across major distributors. IARC Group 2B classification for Sb₂O₃ is simultaneously
triggering specification reviews in automotive, wire and cable, and electronics applications,
compressing the timeline for compounders who have been deferring alternative qualification.

The practical question for procurement is not whether to evaluate alternatives; it is which
zinc-based synergist is the right fit for a given substrate and fire standard. FL-ZS, FL-ZHS, and
FL-ZB each have distinct mechanisms, smoke suppression profiles, and substrate compatibilities. The
comparison table on the [Zinc Synergists page][50] covers all three side by side with ATO.

pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month lead times industry-wide.

Flamisol supplies three zinc-based synergists specifically qualified for ATO reduction and
replacement in halogenated PVC, polyolefin, and engineering plastic compounds.

[View Zinc Alternatives][48] [Read Market Brief][49]

China's export controls on antimony, classified as a strategic material in 2024, combined with mine
curtailments and U.S. trade policy have pushed ATO spot pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month
lead times across major distributors. IARC Group 2B classification for Sb₂O₃ is simultaneously
triggering specification reviews in automotive, wire and cable, and electronics applications,
compressing the timeline for compounders who have been deferring alternative qualification.

zinc-based synergist is the right fit for a given substrate and fire standard. FL-ZS, FL-ZHS, and
FL-ZB each have distinct mechanisms, smoke suppression profiles, and substrate compatibilities. The
comparison table on the [Zinc Synergists page][50] covers all three side by side with ATO.

## Improve the resilience and safety of your materials with next-generation GERPHOS flame retardants

### Powerful, yet halogen-free

Future-proof, high-performance flame retardancy without the use of halogens

### Free from antimony trioxide

Ideal for all safety-concerning applications that regulate the use of antimony trioxide

### Toxic-free and Zero VOCs

Harmless and toxic-free: with no VOCs, GERPHOS is the perfect choice for use in public transport

### Easy to apply in various resins

Blends easily with various polymers, including PVC, polyurethane, and acrylates

### Optimizing production costs

Engineered for each individual material matrix using minimum functional solution

### Faster R&D with rapid testing

Product developers benefit from quick and easy small specimen fire-standard testing

### Color fastness with low pigment dose

Excellent color performance with a lower pigment dosage needed than in conventional flame retardants

#### Apply in ANY resin

#### GERPHOS FLAME RETARDANTS

## Improve the resilience and safety of your materials with next-generation GERPHOS flame retardants

### Powerful, yet halogen-free

Future-proof, high-performance flame retardancy without the use of halogens

### Free from antimony trioxide

Ideal for all safety-concerning applications that regulate the use of antimony trioxide

### Toxic-free and Zero VOCs

Harmless and toxic-free: with no VOCs, GERPHOS is the perfect choice for use in public transport

### Easy to apply in various resins

Blends easily with various polymers, including PVC, polyurethane, and acrylates

### Optimizing production costs

Engineered for each individual material matrix using minimum functional solution

### Faster R&D with rapid testing

Product developers benefit from quick and easy small specimen fire-standard testing

### Color fastness with low pigment dose

Excellent color performance with a lower pigment dosage needed than in conventional flame retardants

## Managing Director Note

**Name :** Jatin Parekh

**Position : **Managing Director

**Experience : **30 Years

Hello everyone, let me take this opportunity to offer my warm greetings and very best wishes to
everyone who visits us online. It is my pleasure to invite you to our official website to get to
know who we are, what we are about and what we do to create value to our customers and our supplier
partners. With our experience of over 2 decades in the Industry, we very well understand the
objective of value creation through our products and services. We do a high level of due diligence
to identify a product and forge partnership with our supplier partners to ensure value creation for
all. With our application centre, our objective is to go that extra mile to first conducting
in-house testing of the raw material before taking it to the customers. This arrangement is
especially done for the surface coating industry.

With competition getting intense by the day, we strive to keep innovating and follow the best
business practices like,
* Studying early advantages and identifying the low hanging fruits
* Having a realistic and consistent ambition
* Strengthening our business model with timely capability development
* Investing in quality manpower
* Constantly working on and evolving our strategy to meet our business goals

As we all know, the global focus is on India. The world wants India to gain in its manufacturing
capabilities and by virtue of that, we see a strong pull for the manufacturing industry to grow.
This will gives us impetus to invest with long term growth plans by adding to our resources at
different locations across India and identifying supplier partners of key raw materials from across
the globe with the objective of value creation to the industry we serve.

For all businesses, whether they are buying or selling, partnerships are the main driving factor to
long term sustainable success. Through our industry specific sales team members, Pan-India
warehousing and sales offices at 10 locations across India, we bring to the table a strong
competence and ability to service customers and markets locally. Life is all about evolving and we
as an organisation will continue to strive to improve ourselves and deliver better than before. We
at HROC are now tougher and more focused, after having learnt a lot from the lockdown, on driving
efficiencies in times of caution. We are ready to make a mark on the world canvas by expanding our
operations in the near future to markets beyond India as specialty chemical solution providers for
our customers and best business partners for our global principals. I take this opportunity, on
behalf of the entire team, to thank you for your continued support and trust in our company. We look
forward to strengthening our relationship and serving you better in the future, if not already.
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or feedback.

Jatin Parekh

## Managing Director Note

**Name :** Jatin Parekh

**Position : **Managing Director

**Experience : **30 Years

Hello everyone, let me take this opportunity to offer my warm greetings and very best wishes to
everyone who visits us online. It is my pleasure to invite you to our official website to get to
know who we are, what we are about and what we do to create value to our customers and our supplier
partners. With our experience of over 2 decades in the Industry, we very well understand the
objective of value creation through our products and services. We do a high level of due diligence
to identify a product and forge partnership with our supplier partners to ensure value creation for
all. With our application centre, our objective is to go that extra mile to first conducting
in-house testing of the raw material before taking it to the customers. This arrangement is
especially done for the surface coating industry.

With competition getting intense by the day, we strive to keep innovating and follow the best
business practices like,
* Studying early advantages and identifying the low hanging fruits
* Having a realistic and consistent ambition
* Strengthening our business model with timely capability development
* Investing in quality manpower
* Constantly working on and evolving our strategy to meet our business goals

As we all know, the global focus is on India. The world wants India to gain in its manufacturing
capabilities and by virtue of that, we see a strong pull for the manufacturing industry to grow.
This will gives us impetus to invest with long term growth plans by adding to our resources at
different locations across India and identifying supplier partners of key raw materials from across
the globe with the objective of value creation to the industry we serve.

For all businesses, whether they are buying or selling, partnerships are the main driving factor to
long term sustainable success. Through our industry specific sales team members, Pan-India
warehousing and sales offices at 10 locations across India, we bring to the table a strong
competence and ability to service customers and markets locally. Life is all about evolving and we
as an organisation will continue to strive to improve ourselves and deliver better than before. We
at HROC are now tougher and more focused, after having learnt a lot from the lockdown, on driving
efficiencies in times of caution. We are ready to make a mark on the world canvas by expanding our
operations in the near future to markets beyond India as specialty chemical solution providers for
our customers and best business partners for our global principals. I take this opportunity, on
behalf of the entire team, to thank you for your continued support and trust in our company. We look
forward to strengthening our relationship and serving you better in the future, if not already.
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or feedback.

Jatin Parekh


Managing Director

# Leading safe progress

At ICL, we develop advanced industrial solutions that impact the lives of millions all over the
world.

From fire safety and personal care to e-mobility and renewable energy, our innovations are a perfect
fit for global-scale industries that prioritize safe and sustainable progress.

## Get to know our innovative solutions

### Flame Retardants

Our FR solutions advance quality of life, while prioritizing human safety, sustainability and
innovation in sectors such as EVs, electronics, building & construction, textile, and more.

[Explore more][207]
[Flame Retardants]

### Industrial

Our industrial solutions influence a wide range of industries, such as transportation, energy
storage, metal, electronics, construction and more.

[Explore more][208]
[Industrial]

### Health & Personal Care

Based on high purity minerals, our wide range of health & personal care solutions advance wellness
and allow our partners to develop healthier, more natural body care products.

[Explore more][209]
[Health & Personal Care]

### Food

We are the world’s leading supplier of mineral-based food-grade supplements for the food industry,
such as magnesium and calcium, which are sourced primarily from the Dead Sea.

[Explore more][210]
[Food]

### Energy

From e-vehicles and renewable energy to oil & gas drilling, our cutting-edge solutions are helping a
wide range of energy sectors take a leap forward.

[Explore more][211]
[Energy]

### Microbial solutions

We offer a wide range of highly effective anti-microbial solutions for industrial applications such
as water systems, cooling towers and paper mills.

[Explore more][212]
[Microbial solutions]

### PrimeDSM

ICL’s magnesium production is based on unique carnallite electrolytic reduction technology. PrimeDSM
has the lowest CO2 emissions of any magnesium production process in the world.

[Explore more][213]
[PrimeDSM]

### Deicing

Dead Sea MAG is a deicing solution that melts ice with high effectiveness and is valued by pet
owners for its paw-friendly qualities.

[Explore more][214]
[Deicing]

### Feed

Our natural-based ingredients enrich feed mixtures and farm animal supplements with nutritional
value and serve as healthy food additives for pets.

[Explore more][215]
[Feed]

### Crop protection

Our solutions provide effective and sustainable crop protection that responds to global food
security challenges.

[Explore more][216]

# Safer World.
# Cleaner Future.

Why take additives at face value

Imagine an eco-friendly flame retardant that delivers the performance you’re looking for – enabling
flame retardancy without compromising on your mechanical performance by its polymeric nature with a
favourable toxic profile.

Now imagine if that same polyphosphonate-based additive is PFAS-free, halogen-free, is non-migrating
and could bring all kinds of added benefits to your products – from transparency to high-thermal
resistance to high tenacity and more..?

## Nofia®: forever safe

We’re Nofia® Solutions. As the original developers of polyphosphonate technology, we help our
customers achieve all these benefits and more with our Nofia® family of polymeric additives.
Designed for tomorrow’s regulations, without compromise. Developed for the manufacturers and brands
whose promises matter, and refuse to choose between safety, performance, and our future health and
environment.

From high-performance plastics to recycled PET fibers, from circuit boards to automotive components,
Nofia’s polymeric technology is redefining what flame retardants can achieve. By delivering
non-leaching, permanent fire safety, Nofia enables industries to design for durability,
recyclability, and tomorrow’s strictest standards — without compromise.

## Our products

Advancing the benchmark with halogen-free, high-performance flame retardants

At Nofia Solutions, we design innovative, eco-friendly, and permanent flame-retardant solutions
trusted by our global customers for their unmatched balance of safety, sustainability, and
performance. Our Nofia® products are non-toxic, non-leaching, and deliver superior fire protection
across industries — from textiles and electronics to construction and transportation

[More information][28]

### Homopolymers

Our Nofia® homopolymers have an exceptionally high limiting oxygen index of 65%, which makes it
particularly well suited to be used as FR additives. Nofia homopolymers are transparent, high
flowing polymers with a glass transition temperature of about 90-105°C. The different grades have
different molecular weights making them suitable for a wide array of applications. From textile
fibers to electrical cables to BOPET and rPET.

### Copolymers

Nofia® copolymers are polyphosphonate-co-carbonates. A range of compositions which can be produced
from high to low phosphonate content. The copolymers have good impact resistance and glass
transition temperatures while maintaining high melt flow and a high limiting oxygen index. They are
typically used in, however not limited to, polycarbonate or PC blends based materials

  2025 / 08 / 18
  
  Nylon (Polyamide，PA) is a type of engineering plastic with excellent overall performance,
  featuring high strength, good wear resistance, excellent self-lubrication, and high chemical
  resistance. It is widely used in the automotive, electrical and electronics, machinery
  manufacturing, and home appliance industries. However, nylon is a flammable polymer, and its
  combustion process is accompanied by high-temperature thermal decomposition and smoke release. Its
  insufficient flame retardancy limits its application, particularly in the electrical and
  electronics and transportation sectors. Therefore, modifying nylon by adding flame retardants is
  an important means of improving its safety performance.

  featuring high strength, good wear resistance, excellent self-lubrication, and high chemical
  resistance. It is widely used in the automotive, electrical and electronics, machinery
  manufacturing, and home appliance industries. However, nylon is a flammable polymer, and its
  combustion process is accompanied by high-temperature thermal decomposition and smoke release. Its
  insufficient flame retardancy limits its application, particularly in the electrical and
  electronics and transportation sectors. Therefore, modifying nylon by adding flame retardants is
  an important means of improving its safety performance.

## Events in the Middle East continue to impact global energy and petrochemical markets. We're here
## to help.

**With shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a route for ~20% of the world’s oil, severely
disrupted, energy prices and feedstock costs are reacting, with knock-on effects for polymer supply,
logistics and pricing.**

Our team are committed to keeping our customers informed and supported. We’re monitoring market
developments and working closely with our global supply network to help you navigate uncertainty and
secure the materials you need.

Qibo Technology specializes in high-performance flame retardant compounds and fire-resistant
chemicals, offering tailored solutions including fire-resistant flame retardant additives for
polymers. Our engineered masterbatches enhance material properties with anti-static protection, UV
resistance (anti-aging), and customized hydrophilicity/hydrophobicity. These innovations serve
critical applications in automotive, construction, and electronics—where thermal safety and material
durability are paramount. Trust our science-driven formulations to meet stringent international
safety standards while optimizing processing efficiency and lifecycle performance.

chemicals, offering tailored solutions including fire-resistant flame retardant additives for
polymers. Our engineered masterbatches enhance material properties with anti-static protection, UV
resistance (anti-aging), and customized hydrophilicity/hydrophobicity. These innovations serve
critical applications in automotive, construction, and electronics—where thermal safety and material
durability are paramount. Trust our science-driven formulations to meet stringent international
safety standards while optimizing processing efficiency and lifecycle performance.

## Two Core Product Lines for Flame Retardant Polymer Applications

compounding, and buyers who need flame retardant masterbatch for easier direct dosing.

**Buyer clarity:** additive or masterbatch **Product scope:** powder, liquid and pellet options
**Selection value:** form, dosing and handling comparison
Line A — Additives

### Flame Retardant Additives

Powders, liquids and compounded polymer additives blended into plastics to reduce flammability.
Halogen-free and halogenated grades for plastic modification, extrusion, injection molding and cable
compound applications.

[White powder flame retardant additive, sieve analysis bench]**Fig. 02** — white powder FR additive,
sieve analysis bench**Proof point: additive form, particle control and QC handling before
formulation.**
* FormsPowder · liquid · compounded blends
* ChemistriesPhosphorus, nitrogen, mineral, brominated + synergists
* Best forIn-house compounding, maximum formulation control
[Explore flame retardant additives →][46] Line B — Masterbatch

### Flame Retardant Masterbatch

Pre-dispersed concentrates of flame retardant additives in a carrier resin. As a flame retardant
masterbatch manufacturer, we customize carrier resin, loading ratio and dispersion performance for
PP, PE, PVC and engineering plastics.

[FR masterbatch pellets exiting an underwater pelletizer]**Fig. 03** — FR masterbatch pellets
exiting underwater pelletizer**Proof point: pelletized masterbatch production, pre-dispersion and
scalable compounding capability.**
* CarriersPP · PE · EVA · PA · custom on request
* Loading40 – 70 % active content, application-dependent
* Best forDirect dosing on extrusion and injection molding lines

Electric Vehicle Battery Market

Industry.

  significantly.
* Increasing electric vehicle adoption is fueling a surge in battery production and investment
  worldwide.
* Eco-friendly battery solutions are gaining traction, promoting recycling and reducing
  environmental impact across industries.

Health & Wellness Markets

solutions

  and personalized than ever.

  health-focused offerings.

Green Hydrogen Market

[ [The Green Hydrogen Market] ][37]

The Green Hydrogen Market: A Sustainable Future Powered by Clean Energy Innovation and Investment
* Green hydrogen is emerging as a game-changing solution for decarbonizing industries and
  transportation sectors globally.
* Innovative technologies and government policies are driving significant investments in green
  hydrogen infrastructure and projects.
* Green hydrogen presents strong potential as demand surges for renewable energy worldwide.

Shifang Taifeng New Flame Retardant Co., Ltd. is a leading national high-tech manufacturer
specializing in the production and research of new halogen-free environmental protection flame
retardants. Our state-of-the-art production line ensures stable quality, with an annual capacity of
over 10,000 tons. For sales and consultation, please contact us for more information on our
innovative flame retardant solutions.

## Why Choose Us

[[Flame Retardant, Fire Inhibitor, Flame Resistant - TFCARE]][24]

When it comes to flame retardants, it is important to prioritize quality, safety, and environmental
responsibility. At Shifang Taifeng New Flame Retardant Co., Ltd., we are proud to offer our
customers a superior product that meets and exceeds these standards. With our dedication to
research, development, and production of halogen-free environmental protection flame retardants, we
have established ourselves as a national high-tech manufacturer with a proven track record of
delivering excellence. So, why choose us? Here are a few compelling reasons.

First and foremost, our commitment to quality is unwavering. We have invested heavily in
state-of-the-art production facilities and processes to ensure that our flame retardants are of the
highest standard. Our production line is equipped with the latest technology and is capable of
maintaining stable quality throughout the manufacturing process. This means that our customers can
rely on consistent and reliable performance from our products, time and time again.

In addition to quality, safety is a top priority for us. We understand the critical role that flame
retardants play in preventing the spread of fires and protecting lives and property. That is why we
have dedicated ourselves to developing halogen-free flame retardants that are not only effective but
also safe for people and the environment. Our products undergo rigorous testing and certification to
ensure that they meet or exceed industry safety standards, giving our customers peace of mind
knowing that they are using a product they can trust.

Furthermore, we take our environmental responsibility seriously. In an age where sustainability is a
key concern, we are proud to offer flame retardants that are not only effective and safe but also
eco-friendly. By eliminating halogens from our formulations, we are reducing the environmental
impact of our products without compromising on performance. This aligns with our commitment to
sustainable and responsible manufacturing, and it gives our customers the opportunity to choose a
product that is better for the planet.

Another reason to choose us is our substantial production capacity. With an annual production
capacity of more than 10,000 tons, we have the ability to meet the needs of our customers, whether
they require small or large quantities of flame retardants. Our efficient production processes and
ample capacity ensure that we can fulfill orders in a timely manner, regardless of size.

Last but certainly not least, our dedication to innovation sets us apart. We are continuously
researching and developing new flame retardant technologies to stay ahead of the curve and
anticipate the evolving needs of the market. Our team of experts is committed to staying at the
forefront of industry trends and technological advancements, ensuring that our customers have access
to the most cutting-edge solutions available.

In conclusion, Shifang Taifeng New Flame Retardant Co., Ltd. is a trusted and reliable partner for
all of your flame retardant needs. With our focus on quality, safety, environmental responsibility,
production capacity, and innovation, we have established ourselves as a leader in the industry. When
you choose us, you are choosing a partner who is deeply committed to delivering excellence in every
aspect of our business.

Supplying specialised VCI anti-rust systems and professional shrink wrap containment services to
protect high-value machinery from weather, transit damage, and corrosion across the nation.
[Speak to Us][43]

We supply a full range of industrial-grade shrink film, heat tools, and accessories.

control, and project-specific needs. We specialise in custom, heavy-duty shrink wrap containment for
large machinery and infrastructure assets.

apply VCI technology to deliver clean, long-term, residue-free protection for metal assets in
storage and transit.

condition, even in the most demanding environments. Additionally, we offer cutting-edge IoT
monitoring devices that provide real-time insights to enhance efficiency and reliability.

With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide comprehensive solutions that protect,

## The Full Circle

# Plastics Processor

Revolutionizing Plastic Manufacturing Processing for Your Thermoforming & Injection Molding Projects

[[Injection Tray]][28]

## Forming Better Solutions

Automatic packaging processes require custom solutions. We work with our clients to design and
produce plastic products that exceed their needs and fit their automation systems seamlessly.

Read more on our work to become one of [GM's Supplier of the Year][29] winners for 2023.

## Forming Better Lives

When you become part of the Vantage Plastics team, you are joining an innovative organization. Each
of our employees contributes to our culture based on our core company values.

[Award-03488]

### Humbly Confident

Confident in our skills, knowledge, and abilities but ready to engage with, listen to, and learn
from others to discover yet even better ways.

[SVSU Award--6_Web]

### All Actions with Integrity

Act with honesty, ethics, and strong moral principles, creating an environment of trust with those
we serve.

[535133494_1217801000387593_1320972340036001715_n]

### Servant Hearts

Serving one another, our customers, our suppliers, and our community to our world locally and
nationally a better place.

[Vantage Machine]

### Pursue Opportunities That Drive Us Forward

Identifying opportunities that will exist in the near future and acting on those that will align
with our mission.

## Forming Sustainable Futures


At Vantage Plastics, we specialize in sustainable solutions across a wide range of processes,
including thin and thick gauge thermoforming, injection molding, plastic sheet extrusion, and
innovative recycling practices. Our products are designed to save you money while actively reducing
environmental impact. By combining advanced manufacturing techniques with a commitment to
sustainability, we help shape a better future for your business and our planet.

[Honda-6237]

## Let's Get Started!

Transform your vision into durable reality with our superior thermoforming and injection molding
services. We craft customized thermoplastic solutions using thick-gauge thermoforming and precision
injection molding techniques. From sturdy components to complex assemblies, our innovative plastic
manufacturing processes ensure unmatched quality.
Partner with experts who deliver excellence in every product.

Revolutionizing Plastic Manufacturing Processing for Your Thermoforming & Injection Molding Projects

## Forming Better Solutions

Automatic packaging processes require custom solutions. We work with our clients to design and
produce plastic products that exceed their needs and fit their automation systems seamlessly.

Read more on our work to become one of [GM's Supplier of the Year][29] winners for 2023.

## Forming Better Lives

When you become part of the Vantage Plastics team, you are joining an innovative organization. Each
of our employees contributes to our culture based on our core company values.

[Award-03488]

### Humbly Confident

Confident in our skills, knowledge, and abilities but ready to engage with, listen to, and learn
from others to discover yet even better ways.

we serve.

[535133494_1217801000387593_1320972340036001715_n]

Serving one another, our customers, our suppliers, and our community to our world locally and
nationally a better place.

[Vantage Machine]

### Pursue Opportunities That Drive Us Forward

Identifying opportunities that will exist in the near future and acting on those that will align
with our mission.

## Forming Sustainable Futures


At Vantage Plastics, we specialize in sustainable solutions across a wide range of processes,
including thin and thick gauge thermoforming, injection molding, plastic sheet extrusion, and
innovative recycling practices. Our products are designed to save you money while actively reducing
environmental impact. By combining advanced manufacturing techniques with a commitment to
sustainability, we help shape a better future for your business and our planet.

[Honda-6237]

## Let's Get Started!

Transform your vision into durable reality with our superior thermoforming and injection molding
services. We craft customized thermoplastic solutions using thick-gauge thermoforming and precision
injection molding techniques. From sturdy components to complex assemblies, our innovative plastic
manufacturing processes ensure unmatched quality.
Partner with experts who deliver excellence in every product.
